summary: Monolith architecture: React + Vite SPA with ASP.NET Core and Azure SQL Database on Azure App Service in centralindia. Driven mainly by infrastructure.existing_systems and project.type; about $45-140/month.

architecture.justification: A team of 2 ships fastest with one deployable application and one database; modules can be split later if needed.

alternatives.why_not: Needs 12+ people, a devops engineer, 1,000,000+ users and scalability priority 4+; here team.size is 2, team.has_devops is false, scale.users_12_months is 1,500, priorities.scalability is 1, team.experience is intermediate.
No workload is heavy enough to need its own service (realtime under 2,000 concurrent users, no model training, no write-heavy iot, analytics or gaming).
Traffic is steady, so always-on servers are cheaper than pay-per-request.

frontend.justification: React + Vite SPA: the screens sit behind sign-in and need no search indexing, so a client-rendered app served as static files is enough and there is no rendering server to run; suited to project.type internal_tool; a 6-week MVP leans on a large library ecosystem; uses javascript, which the team already writes; low operations burden for a team of 2 with no devops engineer. Largest ecosystem and talent pool.

alternatives.why_not: React + Vite SPA is preferred because a 6-week MVP leans on a large library ecosystem.
Angular scores lower on time to market (3.7 against 4.9, priorities.time_to_market is 5), which accounts for 5.8 of the 6.3-point gap.

tradeoffs: Client-side rendering hurts SEO and first load
Routing and data fetching are your choice

backend.justification: ASP.NET Core: suited to project.type internal_tool; uses csharp, which the team already writes, for the 6-week MVP; low operations burden for a team of 2 with no devops engineer. Top-tier TechEmpower throughput.

alternatives.why_not: Fastify (Node.js) scores about as high on its own, but the best full stack built around it totals 0.4 points less once hosting, database and cloud fit are counted.
Azure Functions (Flex Consumption) scores 0.2 points higher on its own, but the best full stack built around it totals 9.5 points less once hosting, database and cloud fit are counted.
Excluded: Firebase (Blaze plan) is offered by Firebase (Google Cloud), but infrastructure.cloud_preference is azure.

tradeoffs: Smaller start-up and open-source community than Node or Python
Azure-first documentation bias

assumptions: Priced for 1,500 monthly active users (the larger of users_at_launch and users_12_months), interpolated between list-price anchors in the knowledge base.
Prices are list prices of the cheapest region inside the chosen residency zone; taxes are excluded.
Database storage is priced for 20 GB (scale.data_volume_gb_12_months).
The upper bound is limited to 3 times the lower bound: the components do not all peak in the same month, so the band stays within one order of magnitude.
Microsoft Entra ID: free tier used at the low end (Free tier includes SSO for unlimited apps and basic features)
GitHub Actions: free tier used at the low end (Free: 2,000 minutes per month on private repos; unlimited on public)
Payment gateway fees (about 2% per transaction), one-time costs, domain names and developer seats are not infrastructure and are excluded.

warnings.message: ISO 27001 certifies the organisation, not the stack: the chosen services' attestations cover their part, but the team still needs its own risk register, access reviews, change records and an external audit.
CERT-In Directions (28 April 2022) require system logs to be kept for 180 days within India and cyber incidents to be reported within 6 hours; set log retention in the India region accordingly.
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Information security management system; Access control and logging. Managed services need attestations: iso27001.
On-prem SQL Server 2019 is past mainstream support and in extended support until 2030-01-08; plan an upgrade to SQL Server 2022 or Azure SQL.
Microsoft 365 is reused. Sign in with the Entra ID tenant behind Microsoft 365 and use Microsoft Graph for mail, calendar and Teams.

Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) is reused. Federate sign-in with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) using OpenID Connect or SAML; keep Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) as the identity source of truth and map groups to roles.

On-prem SQL Server 2019 is reused as the data source, not kept in place. It moves to Azure SQL Database, which keeps the same SQL Server engine and T-SQL; migrate with Azure Database Migration Service or the Data Migration Assistant (DMA) (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dms/dms-overview).

The low end of the estimate relies on free tiers: Microsoft Entra ID (Free tier includes SSO for unlimited apps and basic features); GitHub Actions (Free: 2,000 minutes per month on private repos; unlimited on public). Check them against the expected traffic.
